plan: Represent the authored recipe as immutable input: adapt() shallow-copies ingredients into fresh dicts, rebuilds instructions/equipment, and print_original returns authored_text unchanged, guaranteeing byte-for-byte originals and no input mutation.

Resolve each ingredient (top-level and per-component) against the exclusion set with a recursive chain resolver: pick the catalog choice by min(priority, catalog index), apply the replacement, then recursively re-resolve the replacement and any additional_ingredients so chained substitutions and reintroduced exclusions are handled uniformly.
Carry the path of excluded names down the recursion; a repeat on its own path yields 'substitution cycle involving NAME', a missing catalog entry yields 'no substitution for NAME'.
Accumulate side effects in a resolution record: ordered choice IDs, ordered (old,new) wording changes, equipment additions/removals as sets, a running yield factor, warnings and reasons as sets.

Judge feasibility only after processing everything: compute final equipment as (base - removals) | additions, add 'equipment NAME unavailable' for each item outside available_equipment, and if any reasons exist return {possible: false, recipe: null, choices considered, sorted warnings, sorted reasons} listing every independent reason.

Scale late and uniformly: multiply every quantity (replacements, extras, components) by target_yield / (authored yield x applied yield_factors), so the result sits exactly at the target yield even when substitutions change yield.

Apply wording changes as ordered str.replace passes over fresh instruction strings (components too); emit equipment sorted; return {possible: true, recipe, ordered choices, sorted warnings, reasons: []}.

Embed an executable __main__ acceptance suite covering all seven contract cases: 3->5 scaling, chained substitution, verb+equipment substitution, reintroduced exclusion, multiple simultaneous reasons, exact original print with input immutability, and priority/order-deterministic choice, plus a cycle-reason and yield-factor check.
mechanisms: copy-on-adapt working state (input immutability + byte-exact authored_text passthrough)
deterministic catalog selection by min(priority, catalog index)
recursive chain resolver with ancestor-name path for chaining and cycle detection
accumulate-then-judge diagnostics set reporting all independent impossibility reasons
late uniform scaling: quantity_factor at authored yield, then one target_yield/effective_yield multiplier
equipment as set algebra (base - removals | additions) with sorted output and subset check
ordered str.replace wording-change passes over fresh instruction strings
